title: Foo Bar Moose CSV Ingest
description: Load five messy CSV files into a clean ClickHouse table by bootstrapping a Moose project and running Moose in dockerless mode.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must bootstrap a Moose project, start dockerless Moose services, and load five messy CSV files into a clean ClickHouse table.

tasks.description: Create a Moose project in /workspace and load all five CSV files into ClickHouse while cleaning data issues along the way.

infrastructure.description: No services are prestarted. Five messy CSV files are seeded in /data/csv/, and the agent must bootstrap Moose in /workspace and run `moose dev --dockerless`.
